name: Get Channel Messages
description: Get recent messages from a Slack conversation.

channelId.description: The Slack conversation or channel ID.

limit.description: The maximum number of messages to return.

cursor.description: The Slack pagination cursor from a previous page. Omit for the first page.

oldest.description: Only return messages after this Slack timestamp, for example '1700000000.123456'. The message at exactly this timestamp is included only when inclusive is true.

latest.description: Only return messages before this Slack timestamp. Defaults to now. The message at exactly this timestamp is included only when inclusive is true.

inclusive.description: Include messages whose timestamp equals oldest or latest. Slack ignores this unless one of those bounds is set.

includeRaw.description: When true, each returned message also carries the untouched Slack record under raw, including its blocks, attachments, files and message metadata. Defaults to false.

input_schema.description: Input parameters for reading Slack conversation history.

name: Search Context
description: Search Slack messages with the granular Real-time Search API.

items.description: The Slack channel type to search.

contextChannelId.description: The channel ID used to scope the search when applicable.

cursor.description: The cursor for the next page.

limit.description: The number of results to return.

sort.description: How Slack should sort search results.

sortDir.description: The sort direction for Slack search results.

before.description: Only return messages before this UNIX timestamp.

after.description: Only return messages after this UNIX timestamp.

includeContextMessages.description: Whether to include surrounding context messages.

includeBots.description: Whether to include messages posted by bots.

includeMessageBlocks.description: Whether to include message blocks in the results.

highlight.description: Whether Slack should highlight matching terms.

termClauses.description: Search term clauses that every result must match.

modifiers.description: Slack search modifiers without free-text terms.

name: Search Messages

sort.description: How Slack should sort search results.

sortDir.description: The sort direction for Slack search results.

teamId.description: The encoded team ID to search when using an org-level token.

includeRaw.description: When true, each returned match also carries the untouched Slack search match under raw, including any blocks, attachments and files. Defaults to false.
